archetypes.name: dependency-chain
archetypes.rationale: The plan hard-gates on PR #3548 merging first; if the branch-only file categorization is wrong, items 1/2/4/6 would edit wrong targets or conflict with base.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the plan's branch-dependency claim: for each of items 1, 2, 4, and 6, confirm that the target files (`skills/design/scripts/assess-plan-round.sh`, `skills/design/scripts/tally-plan-review.sh`, `scripts/check-scope-reduction-marker.sh`, `SECURITY.md`) exist only on branch `sergey-zhupanov/implementing-design-review-anchor-scout-3511` and not on current main—or, if they do exist on main, that the plan's edits are safe to apply to either version. Cross-check whether items 3 and 5 (claimed to target already-landed main-branch code) reference any symbols, functions, or call-site conventions introduced only by that branch. Flag any mis-categorized items where the plan's branch-only assumption would cause a conflict or a no-op edit. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: kv-propagation
archetypes.rationale: The plan adds SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE KV to tally-plan-review.sh but lists only two emitting paths; missing a terminal path or downstream consumer causes silent anchor loss with no test failure.
archetypes.prompt_body: Enumerate every terminal exit path in `skills/design/scripts/tally-plan-review.sh` and check whether each either emits `SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE` (per the plan) or has an explicit documented reason to omit it; the plan names only `ok` and `main-agent-vote-required` as emitting and `tally-error` as intentionally omitting—verify this is exhaustive. Identify every downstream caller that parses tally KV output (`plan-review-loop.sh`, any Step 3 orchestrator in SKILL.md, CI harnesses) and confirm the plan accounts for each consumer reading or forwarding the new key. Check whether the SKILL.md orchestrator prose change (replacing "preserve existing SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE" prose with mechanical KV passthrough) is the only prose site that needs updating, or whether other step descriptions also carry preservation language. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
